warnings: Warnings For external use only. Do not use on damaged or broken skin. When using this product keep out of eyes. Rinse with water to remove. do not puncture or incinerate. Contents under pressure. Do not store at temperatures above 120F. Stop use and ask doctor if rash occurs. Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Flammable: Do not use near heat, flame or while smoking.

dosage_and_administration: Directions Shake well before using. Hold container 4 to 6 inches from the skin to apply. apply liberally and spread evenly by hand 15 minutes before sun exposure and as needed. reapply: after 80 minutes of swimming or sweating immediately after towel drying at least every 2 hours. Do not spray directly onto face. Spray into hands and apply to face, avoiding the eye area. Do not apply in windy conditions. Use in a well-ventilated area. Sun Protection Measures: Spending time in the sun increases your risk of skin cancer and early skin aging. To decrease this risk, regularly use a sunscreen with a Broad-Spectrum SPF value of 15 or higher and other sun protection measures including: limit time in the sun, especially from 10 a.m. —2 p.m. wear long-sleeved shirts, pants, hats, and sunglasses. children under 6 months of age: Ask a doctor.
